title: A constexpr Config Parser
prompt: Implement `parseSpec` as a `constexpr` function: split on `;`, each entry on the first `:`, trim spaces, store name and int value, and return the count. The test bakes the result into a compile-time constant — the proof that the whole parser runs before main.

tests.name: runtime parse works
tests.hint: Walk the string_view: find ';' and ':', substr, trim ' ', std::stoi is NOT constexpr — parse the digits yourself (v = v*10 + (c - '0')).

tests.name: compile-time parse works
tests.hint: constexpr functions may mutate local arrays — the lambda runs the same code at compile time; keep every operation constexpr-legal (no std::stoi, no allocations).
